status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: AI actors should provide meaningful information making stakeholders aware of interactions with AI, including workplace interactions.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: Section 1.3(ii) is nonbinding interaction-awareness guidance. The company describes director profile cloning without identifying the synthetic medium or whether the employee interacted with an AI participant rather than consuming human-delivered media. The necessary interaction object and responsible disclosure actor remain unresolved, so no benchmark finding is made.

review.reason_for_change: The preserved object is a static military-ID or profile/likeness representation created and used by people. No autonomous AI participant or actual interaction with the generation system by the victim is established. Source-origin deception is distinct from the specific AI-interaction-awareness proposition.

review.requirement_proposition: Protect vulnerable users, require specific consent for bounded deceptive styles, document emergent deception and define safeguard-failure protocols.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: Starmangalsutra reported director impersonation and substantial fraudulent transfers discovered in July 2026, without identifying the generating system. For IEEE-7014.1 6.7.3(l-p), the missing applicability fact is whether the operator adopted IEEE 7014.1 for an emulated-empathy GPAI partner in the interaction and the applicable vulnerable-user or deceptive-style safeguard context; impersonation imagery or task deception alone does not establish a human–AI partnering undertaking. Taxonomy correspondence does not supply these scope facts; no occurrence-level requirement finding is recorded.

review.reason_for_change: 6.7.3(l-p) governs partner-based/emulated-empathy vulnerability/style safeguards or emotional-data consent. These human-directed facial-composite, static-ID, executive-profile or social-profile impersonations do not instantiate the partner-system/affective consent object. For the 2024/2025 occurrences the 2026 source also postdates the event.

review.requirement_proposition: AI actors should respect the rule of law, human rights and democratic and human-centred values throughout the AI lifecycle, including non-discrimination, equality, freedom, dignity, individual autonomy, privacy and data protection, diversity, fairness, social justice and internationally recognised labour rights.
review.reason_for_change: The company's direct filing reports deepfake/profile-clone director impersonation used to obtain employee transfers, and the real director denied giving those instructions. For that attributed July 2026 sequence, the AI-mediated false person-bound authority contradicted individual autonomy and identity/dignity. This is a bounded occurrence finding on the company's account, not a determination of the production technique, criminal liability or specific generator safeguards.

review.requirement_proposition: Add intended purpose, nominal operator and responsible contact information to the public documentation.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: IEEE 7001 Table 2 level 3 requires an autonomous-system scope and relevant transparency/conformance context. The company discloses deepfake/profile cloning but no exact production medium, autonomous participant, operator documentation or conformance undertaking. Human receipt of false payment authority does not establish these facts.

review.reason_for_change: Table 2 level 3 concerns autonomous-system identification or public purpose/operator/contact documentation. A human-directed static ID/profile image or unidentified impersonation medium is not an established autonomous-system interaction or the generation system's documentation activity.

review.requirement_proposition: Parties must ensure adequate transparency requirements tailored to the context and risk of AI lifecycle activities, including identification of AI-generated content.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: Article 8 addresses Parties and their territorial implementation of the Convention. The the July 2026 Starmangalsutra transfer fraud evidence establishes neither entry into force for the relevant Party nor implementation covering the private actor’s activity. Signature, a civil settlement or corporate fraud disclosure does not supply those applicability facts.

review.reason_for_change: Article 8 governs a treaty Party's implementation of transparency/contestability duties. The private perpetrators, companies or bank-verification applications identify no commenced relevant Party implementation/territorial duty.

review.requirement_proposition: Do not apply affective modeling to identifiable subject data without prior informed consent.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: Starmangalsutra reported director impersonation and substantial fraudulent transfers discovered in July 2026, without identifying the generating system. For IEEE-7014 4.3.5.2(d), the missing applicability fact is whether the developer undertook IEEE 7014 for an emulated-empathy system applying affective modelling to identifiable subject affective data; image depiction, face swapping or identity matching does not by itself establish affective modelling, and the anonymous-data exception cannot be resolved without that processing scope. Taxonomy correspondence does not supply these scope facts; no occurrence-level requirement finding is recorded.

review.reason_for_change: 4.3.5.2(d) prohibits unconsented affective modelling of identifiable data. Identity likeness transformation is not evidence of modelling a subject's emotions/affect; the technical subject matter differs.

review.requirement_proposition: Make the system clearly identifiable as autonomous to users and bystanders.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: IEEE 7001 Table 2 level 1 requires an autonomous-system scope and relevant transparency/conformance context. The company discloses deepfake/profile cloning but no exact production medium, autonomous participant, operator documentation or conformance undertaking. Human receipt of false payment authority does not establish these facts.

review.reason_for_change: Table 2 level 1 concerns autonomous-system identification or public purpose/operator/contact documentation. A human-directed static ID/profile image or unidentified impersonation medium is not an established autonomous-system interaction or the generation system's documentation activity.

review.requirement_proposition: Parties must seek to ensure that people interacting with AI are told they are interacting with a system rather than a human, as appropriate to the context.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: Article 15(2) addresses Parties and their territorial implementation of the Convention. The the July 2026 Starmangalsutra transfer fraud evidence establishes neither entry into force for the relevant Party nor implementation covering the private actor’s activity. Signature, a civil settlement or corporate fraud disclosure does not supply those applicability facts.

review.reason_for_change: Article 15(2) governs a treaty Party's implementation of transparency/contestability duties. The private perpetrators, companies or bank-verification applications identify no commenced relevant Party implementation/territorial duty.

review.requirement_proposition: Do not place, put into service or use AI that deploys subliminal, purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques causing materially distorted behavior and significant harm.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: The Indian company reports substantial transfers following a director impersonation using deepfake methods, but the source does not identify the generating AI system or establish an EU-market provider, Union-established deployer, or output used in the Union. The reported harm makes the occurrence materially relevant, while the Article 2 connection needed to determine scope is absent.

review.reason_for_change: The registered 2026-07-27 source version (Article 5(1)(a)) postdates the reported application/phishing/transfer/impersonation occurrence. No later report or settlement retrospectively supplies the defined territorial high-risk/prohibition conditions.

review.requirement_proposition: Minimise data and make review, modification and withdrawal of consent immediate and accessible.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: Starmangalsutra reported director impersonation and substantial fraudulent transfers discovered in July 2026, without identifying the generating system. For IEEE-7014.1 6.22.3(a-b), the missing applicability fact is whether the developer or platform operator adopted IEEE 7014.1 for a partner-based GPAI system using emulated empathy and collecting personal, emotional, memory or relationship-history data in this occurrence; public output or stored task content alone does not establish that partnering and consent-control scope. Taxonomy correspondence does not supply these scope facts; no occurrence-level requirement finding is recorded.

review.reason_for_change: 6.22.3(a-b) governs partner-based/emulated-empathy vulnerability/style safeguards or emotional-data consent. These human-directed facial-composite, static-ID, executive-profile or social-profile impersonations do not instantiate the partner-system/affective consent object. For the 2024/2025 occurrences the 2026 source also postdates the event.

review.requirement_proposition: Document interactions with GAI systems to users prior to interactive activities, particularly in contexts involving more significant risks.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: GV-5.1-002 addresses disclosure before interactive GAI activities. The synthetic modality, generation system, interactive user pathway and responsible actor’s Profile undertaking are unpublished; no applicability or breach is inferred from the company’s deepfake characterization.

review.reason_for_change: The action documents GAI interactions to users before interactive activity. The observed object is a static image/profile, with no victim interaction with the generation system or identified interactive GAI participant; the specific user-interaction documentation scope is absent.

conclusion_change.previous: Human attackers reportedly used a cloned representation of the director to supply false payment authority, and the employee transferred funds. The deceptive economic request and the unauthorised use of the director’s identity representation are separate mechanisms. The company’s description supports the latter at medium confidence even though the exact source media and generator are unpublished. No autonomous AI objective, preexisting safeguard failure or eventual recovery amount is established. Company-reported director impersonation and subsequent denial support separate economic, likeness and social-engineering failures, while production modality, interaction, compromise path and recovery remain unpublished. Requirement scope is unresolved where it depends on autonomous or interactive GAI processing; no duty is inferred from a synthetic profile alone.
conclusion_change.new: Human attackers reportedly used a cloned representation of the director to supply false payment authority, and the employee transferred funds. The deceptive economic request and the unauthorised use of the director’s identity representation are separate mechanisms. The company’s description supports the latter at medium confidence even though the exact source media and generator are unpublished. No autonomous AI objective, preexisting safeguard failure or eventual recovery amount is established. Company-reported director impersonation and subsequent denial support separate economic, likeness and social-engineering failures, while production modality, interaction, compromise path and recovery remain unpublished. Independent OECD autonomy/privacy/dignity assessment is Not aligned for the company-reported false director representation and resulting transfers. Autonomous/interactive-system transparency, affective modelling and later statutory-source candidates remain audit-only because their specific objects/timing are not established. No hidden generator safeguard or eventual recovery is inferred.
